# Third-Party Libraries

All three libraries are bundled locally. The lecture does not request these scripts from a CDN at runtime.

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lucide.min.js | [Lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide) | 1.8.0 | ISC, with MIT-licensed Feather derivatives; see lucide-LICENSE.txt |
| jszip.min.js | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.1 | MIT or GPLv3; used under MIT; see jszip-LICENSE.md |
| papaparse.min.js | [Papa Parse](https://github.com/mholt/PapaParse) | 5.5.3 | MIT; see papaparse-LICENSE.txt |

Original copyright and license notices are retained in the adjacent license files and distributed builds.
